fitted with a line of least squares (abline)
I just can't figure out how to plot confidence bands on my graph??
This is the code i have so far.


V<-Y1$LogVariance
M<-Y1$LogMean

plot(M,V, main="Relationship V and M", xlab="LogMean",
ylab="LogVariance")

m<-lm(V~M)

abline(m)

do i use ggplot2 for this or is there another package/function better
suited?
any help/hints/tips very much appreciated

parts:
ggplot2 is totally different than the base graphics you are using (with plot and abline).  

Your solution in ggplot2 graphics is very simple -

library(ggplot2)

# in general...
qplot(speed, dist, data = cars, geom = c('smooth','point'), method = 'lm')

# for you...
qplot(LogMean, LogVariance, data = Y1, geom = c('smooth','point'), 
  method = 'lm', main = 'Relationship V and M')
